title: ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT AND JOBS COMMITTEE REPORT relative to short-term targeted assistance for small businesses negatively impacted by external economic…
text:
[Council File 26-0069]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT AND JOBS COMMITTEE REPORT relative to short-term targeted assistance for small businesses negatively impacted by external economic conditions, policy shifts, and local business interruptions.
Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. DIRECT the General Manager, Community Investment Department (CID), or designee, to continue supporting local businesses with existing programs, and identify opportunities and resources to recommend new policies and programs for expanded short-term, targeted financial assistance for negatively impacted businesses.
2. AUTHORIZE CID to reprogram $2,373,622.24 of Community Development Block Grant Coronavirus Aid, Relief, and Economic Security (CARES) Act (CDBG-CV) funding to continue the implementation of the Assistance to Microenterprises Grant Program to support eligible businesses with long-term negative effects caused by COVID-19, as follows:
a. Assistance to Microenterprises Grant Program: $2,000,000.00
b. Program Bank Fees: $1,000
c. Personnel and related costs: $372,622.24
3. AUTHORIZE CID to disburse Program Year (PY) 46 CDBG-CV funds (previously reprogrammed from PY 46) from the Community Development Trust Fund No. 424/21, Account No. 21AC1V (CV 19 - Microenterprise), and electronically transfer up to $2,000,000 to U.S. Bank for disbursement of grants to eligible and approved microenterprise businesses.
4. AUTHORIZE CID to disburse and electronically transfer up to $1,000 from the Community Development Trust Fund No. 424/21, Account No. 21AC1V (CV 19 - Microenterprise) to U.S. Bank for bank fees incurred by the Assistance to Microenterprise Grant Program.
5. AUTHORIZE the General Manager, CID, or designee, to execute a contract amendment to City Contract C-203885 with ICF Environmental for the purpose of conducting additional Section 106 historic preservation reviews by adding $25,000 in Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) funding (comprised of $5,000 in CDBG Admin and $20,000 in CDBG Program) for a new total contract amount of $50,000 and extending the term through June 30, 2027.
6. AUTHORIZE the Controller to:
a. Decrease appropriations within the Community Development Trust Fund No. 424/21 (CARES-CV) as follows:
i. Account No. 43T10C; LA Rise City GF Homeless Program; ($7,241.06)
ii. Account No. 43TC3V; CV19-CHILDCARE SUPPORT; ($205,532.36)
iii. Account No. 21W233; CV 19 Adm Reserve; ($102,925.55)
iv. Account No. 21Y143; Housing; ($1,110,410.87)
v. Account No. 43T122; Economic and Workforce Development; ($119,564.13)
vi. Account No. 43T143; Housing and Community Investment; ($665,300.98)
vii. Account No. 21Y143; Housing; ($71,991.29)
viii. Account No. 21A154; Capital Improvement Expense Program; ($90,656.00)
b. Increase appropriations within the Community Development Trust Fund No. 424/21 (CARES-CV) as follows:
i. Account No. 21AC1V; CV 19 - MICROENTERPRISE (Small Business); $2,000,000.00
ii. Account No. 21AC1V; CV 19 - MICROENTERPRISE (Small Business); $1,000.00
iii. Account No. 21E121; Community Investment; $217,576.92
iv. Account No. 21E299; Reimbursement of General Fund; $155,045.32
c. Increase appropriations in the amount of $217,576.92 for Appropriation Account No. 001010 Salaries General within Fund No.100/21 Community Investment Department.
d. Decrease appropriations within the Community Development Trust Fund No. 424/21 (CDBG-REG) as follows:
i. Account No. 21Y184; Bureau of Street Lighting; ($1,847.15)
ii. Account No. 21A184; Bureau of Street Lighting; ($62.63)
iii. Account No. 21W140; General Services; ($18,090.22)
iv. Account No. 21E299; Reimbursement of General Fund; ($5,000.00)
e. Increase appropriations within the Community Development Trust Fund No. 424/21 (CDBG-REG) as follows:
i. Account No. 21E594; Environmental Consultant; $25,000.00
7. REQUEST the Office of the City Administrative Officer (CAO) to identify and recommend funding sources (e.g., General Fund reserve, reprogrammed grant funds, or a new appropriation) to capitalize expanded short-term assistance programs, and to report on the associated fiscal impact.
8. REQUEST the CAO to evaluate the feasibility of establishing an emergency reserve fund to provide rapid financial support during severe events that adversely impact local businesses.
9. AUTHORIZE the General Manager, CID, or designee, to prepare technical corrections to transactions included in this report, subject to the approval of the Chief Legislative Analyst (CLA), to carry out Mayor and City Council intentions, as necessary, and authorize the Controller to implement those instructions.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The CID reports that the recommendations in the report will have no impact on the General Fund.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Council reprograms about $2.37 million in federal pandemic-era CDBG-CV funds to continue grants for microenterprises hurt by COVID-19 effects, and approves a $25,000 contract amendment and related budget transfers. The Community Investment Department reports no General Fund impact.
